metadata.optimizationNotes: All images converted to WebP with JPG fallback for older browsers

template.notes: This template should be populated for each entity with empty image folders. Use this as the base to update existing info.json files or create new ones.

field_descriptions.id: Unique identifier from data catalog (often same as slug)
field_descriptions.name: Human-readable display name
field_descriptions.imageFolder: Path to images directory from project root
field_descriptions.coverImage: Primary hero image (used for listings, cards, OG tags)
field_descriptions.fallbackFormat: Legacy format for browsers without WebP support
field_descriptions.useWebPWithFallback: If true, serve WebP with JPG fallback via <picture> tag
field_descriptions.metadata.assetCount: Total number of images (hero + gallery + optional menu)
field_descriptions.metadata.totalSize: Approximate total size of all images
field_descriptions.metadata.lastUpdated: ISO 8601 date of last image update
field_descriptions.metadata.optimizationNotes: Any notes about optimization or conversion process

validation_checklist: ☐ All image files exist and are > 0 bytes
☐ JPG fallbacks exist if useWebPWithFallback is true
☐ All alt texts are descriptive and SEO-optimized
☐ Source URLs are valid and point to official or CC-licensed content
☐ image folder path exists on disk
